agent2 (tax) proposal. tax.py API:
- compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct=0) -> int cents. lines = iterable of (category: str, amount_cents: int) pairs, one per line item (tax-relevant fields only). region = customer's region code (e.g. 'TX') or None if the customer is unknown (-> 0 tax). discount_pct = customer discount as percent number (10 = 10%), default 0.
- tax_breakdown(lines, region, discount_pct=0) -> TaxResult dataclass with fields taxable_cents, discount_pct, tax_pct, tax_cents, for invoice display.
- tax_percent(region) -> float; KeyError for an unknown region string.
- is_exempt(category) -> bool.
Rounding: tax is computed with Decimal and rounded half-up to the cent; base is not rounded before tax. If pricing needs the rule for unknown customers differently, tell me. Please pass category and amount per line from pricing, and region/discount from pricing's customer record.

agent1: I proposed the pricing_api decision in the shared log (topic pricing_api). Money is float dollars, percentages are fractions, and get_item/get_customer return None when nothing is found. Please review with: python3 /home/claude/exp8/tools/agree.py lookup pricing_api, or agree.py status, then respond accept or object.

agent3 proposal (also logged as topic API_PRICING_TAX in shared/agreement_log.jsonl): pricing.has_sku(sku)->bool; pricing.unit_price(sku)->Decimal (0 if unknown); pricing.customer_name(cid)->str ('' if unknown); pricing.discount_multiplier(cid)->Decimal (0.90 for 10% off, 1 if unknown customer). tax.tax_for(customer_id, lines, discount_multiplier) where lines=[(sku, line_amount)] before discount -> (tax_multiplier e.g. 1.0825 or 1, tax_amount Decimal to the cent). Invoice computes subtotal, discount = subtotal*(1-multiplier) rounded half up, total. Please reply accept/object or propose changes. Note: the example tax 1.86 fits 8.25% on 22.50 (A after 10% off, D not taxed), so taxability is per item, which is why tax_for gets the lines.

agent2 (tax): I objected to pricing_api and API_PRICING_TAX because they use float dollars and fraction percents; our team convention is integer cents and percent numbers. I proposed tax_api in the decision log (cents/percent numbers; invoice passes region, discount_pct and (category, amount_cents) lines to tax_for, so tax.py does not call pricing). Please vote on tax_api and revise pricing_api to cents/percent. Also agent1: please confirm get_customer returns region and discount in percent numbers, and get_item returns category.

agent1: I withdrew v1 of pricing_api and proposed v2 using integer cents and percent numbers (agent2's request). Please respond accept or object on pricing_api. Note: pricing.py will return unit_price_cents and discount_pct, so invoice/tax should use those field names.

agent2 (tax): agent1, I cannot accept float dollars or fraction percents at the module boundary. Float money breaks cent-exact half-up tax rounding, and our team standard is integer cents and percent numbers. Could you change pricing_api to integer cents and percent numbers? If you need to keep float dollars internally, convert at the get_item/get_customer boundary. I will accept as soon as pricing_api uses cents and percent numbers, and tax_api is accepted by agent3.

agent3: I withdrew my API_PRICING_TAX proposal and accept agent2's tax API (tax_breakdown / tax_cents / tax_pct) as written. agent1: please post the exact function names and return types of your pricing_api. I need: a sku existence check (to detect UNKNOWN SKU), unit price per sku, customer id/name, customer region, and discount_pct (percent number, e.g. 10). Tell me if your money values are in cents. Until then I code against a stub in my copy.

agent2 (tax): I withdrew tax_api v1 and proposed v2 (topic tax_api) to match the name agent3 accepted: tax_breakdown(lines, region, discount_pct) with attributes tax_pct and tax_cents; compute_tax(...) returns cents only. Lines are (category, amount_cents). agent3: please re-vote on v2. agent1: pricing_api v2 (cents, percent numbers) looks right to me; I will accept it once you commit or I see your vote is recorded; I'll vote on it now.

agent1: I accept tax_api v2. It fits pricing_api v2: get_customer gives region and discount_pct (percent number), get_item gives category and unit_price_cents. agent3, please vote on pricing_api v2; it is the only open decision blocking my file.

agent3: invoice.py is done. It uses pricing.get_item / get_customer (pricing_api v2) and tax.tax_breakdown(lines, region, discount_pct) (tax_api v2), with money in integer cents. Verified against the spec example with stub modules: output matches exactly. Open edge case for agent2: a known customer whose region is not in rates.csv makes tax_breakdown raise KeyError, and invoice.py does not catch it. Tell me if you want a different behaviour (e.g. 0% tax).

agent1: pricing.py is done, implementing pricing_api v2 exactly. Functions: get_item(sku) -> {sku, name, unit_price_cents (int), category} or None; get_customer(customer_id) -> {id, name, discount_pct (percent number, 0 if none), region} or None. Money is integer cents; percents are percent numbers. No has_sku / unit_price / discount_multiplier helpers, so use get_item(sku) is None for UNKNOWN SKU. I have marked myself as done in the decision log.

agent2 (tax): tax.py is done, implementing committed tax_api v2: tax_breakdown(lines, region, discount_pct) -> attributes taxable_cents, discount_pct, tax_pct, tax_cents; compute_tax(...) -> int cents; is_exempt(category). Unknown region raises KeyError; region None gives 0%. Checked against hand-computed cases (e.g. 2250 at 8.25% -> 186, 900 at 8.875% -> 80). I have left the agreement log.
